query.description: Chain Layer 연결 규칙 저장 (InsertExecuteMultiple, 허용 오차는 G17 문자열)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, SECOND_LAYER_ID, TOLERANCE) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :chain_seq, 1, :first_layer_id, :second_layer_id, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:tolerance))

SELECT FIRST_LAYER_ID, SECOND_LAYER_ID, TOLERANCE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq AND VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY FIRST_LAYER_ID, SECOND_LAYER_ID

query.description: Map 복사: Chain Layer 연결 규칙
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, SECOND_LAYER_ID, TOLERANCE) SELECT FACTORY, :target_device_id, :new_chain_seq, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, SECOND_LAYER_ID, TOLERANCE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :source_device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :source_chain_seq

query.description: Chain Layer(번호 + DataType) 연결 규칙 저장 (InsertExecuteMultiple, 허용 오차는 G17 문자열)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE, TOLERANCE) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :chain_seq, 1, :first_layer_id, :first_data_type, :second_layer_id, :second_data_type, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:tolerance))

query.description: Chain Layer(번호 + DataType) 연결 규칙 조회
query.commandtext: SELECT FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE, TOLERANCE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq AND VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE

query.description: Map 복사: Chain Layer(번호 + DataType) 연결 규칙
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE, TOLERANCE) SELECT FACTORY, :target_device_id, :new_chain_seq, VERSION_NO, FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE, TOLERANCE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :source_device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :source_chain_seq

query.description: Chain 번호 범위의 Layer(번호 + DataType) 연결 규칙 일괄 조회. GDS Map View 가 Chain 이 많을 때 Chain 마다 조회하지 않도록 (2026-10-21)
query.commandtext: SELECT CHAIN_SEQ, FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE, TOLERANCE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_RULE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ BETWEEN :from_seq AND :to_seq AND VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY CHAIN_SEQ, FIRST_LAYER_ID, FIRST_DATA_TYPE, SECOND_LAYER_ID, SECOND_DATA_TYPE
